title: Austin Leaders Enter Closed Session
summary:
*   **Special Meeting Convened:** Austin officials gathered for a special meeting focused on a single, critical procedural matter.
*   **Closed-Door Executive Session:** The main purpose was to announce and immediately proceed into a private executive session.
*   **Legally Authorized Discussions:** This confidential meeting was held under specific Texas statutes, indicating sensitive or privileged topics.
*   **Commitment to Public Action:** Any final votes or decisions resulting from the closed session were guaranteed to be made public.
transcript:
= CITY OF AUSTIN. TEXAS
MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
Special Meeting
January 16, 1975
12:00 ΝΟΟΝ
Council Chambers
301 West Second Street
The meeting was called to order with Mayor Butler presiding. Roll Call: Present:
Councilmen Dryden, Lebermann, Mayor Butler, Mayor Pro Tem Love
Absent:
Councilmen Binder, Friedman
Mayor Butler announced that this was a Special Called Meeting of the City Council for the
purpose of publicly announcing that during the Meeting it will convene in a Closed or
Executive Session authorized by Section 2, Paragraphs (e), (f), and (g) of Article
6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated; and after such closed or executive
session, any final antion, decision, or vote with regard to any matter considered in the
closed or executive session would be made in open session, should such action, decision,
or vote be necessary.
Mayor Butler announced that the Council would go into Executive Session at this time to
consider the items authorized in Section 2, Pragraphs (e), (f), and (g) of Article
6252-17.
